description: Replaces dependabot once the Mend Renovate GitHub App is installed on the repo. Mirrors the old cadence (weekly, grouped minor+patch, PRs against dev — memory rule: test locally on dev before merging) and adds what dependabot lacked: Gradle (android), CocoaPods (ios), the dependency dashboard issue, and lockfile maintenance.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: majors stay individual PRs — release-notes check for required code changes is part of the merge procedure
